findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

Observed raw shell eggs above ready-to-eat foods (grapes). Ensure eggs stay below RTE items to prevent against cross contamination. Inspector moved the eggs to the same level as the grapes (nothing on shelf below). Discuss with staff to ensure they are aware of appropriate storage order. Storage order placement of foods infographic is available in the kitchen manager’s office (taped to the side of the filing cabinet). Discussed with PIC. PIC indicated she would review storage order with staff. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the interior baffle of the ice machine in the kitchen to have a layer of mildew and mold upon wiping with paper towel. Mold was visible, as well. Discussed routine cleaning of the interior of the ice machine with PIC. PIC instructed employees to begin removing the ice from the ice machine and wash, rinsing, and sanitizing the interior of the machine. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The bucket of sanitizer used in the kitchen is observed to barely register a color change on the inspector’s or facility’s test strips. This indicated a concentration in the double digits when 200 ppm is the minimum for quat. Food handling/ preparation was taking place at this time and this is the only bucket observed in this area. The bucket was remade to correct.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment: 3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. A can of corn is observed with a significant dent in the upper rim. A conversation took place in relation to dangerous areas for a dent to be located, and the can was moved by the PIC to a donation location. Food program supervisor for the school system (Chad) donates damaged cans of unopened foods from the schools.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11 (C) (C) Non FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Mold was observed on the outer surface of a container of worshire sauce in the walk in cooler. The PIC was notified of the issue and the container was cleaned during the inspection to correct. No mold was observed on surrounding containers or inside of the effected container.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15  (Pf) Food packaging on containers of beef and chicken base have mold growing on the outside of the containers. Food packaging must be in good condition so that foods are not exposed to adulteration or potential contamination. The containers were discarded during the inspection.
